outcome: Decision to have a natural delivery
Awareness, attitude, perceived behaviour control, subjective norms, and behavioural intention
cohort: 200 women in their third trimester of pregnancy opting for elective caesarean section
finding: Both educational interventions increased model construct scores, but the combination of educational package and group discussion was more effective in influencing women to choose natural delivery.
mod_finding: While the study examined the effect of education on choosing vaginal delivery over elective c-section, it did not appear to directly analyze how existing modes of delivery impacted the intervention.
